{{a|Aerilate}}{{tt|*|As Mega Salamence}} | type1=Dragon | type2=Flying | media=special | epnum=PS252| epname=The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XIV | prevonum=373 | current=[[Party|With Zinnia]] | noevo=incap | va=no | }} '''Zinnia's Salamence''' (Japanese: '''ヒガナのボーマンダ''' ''Higana's Bohmander'') is a Pokémon that [[Zinnia]] owns in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}} and the {{pkmn|games}}. ==In the manga== ===History=== ====Prior to the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}==== [[File:Zinnia Salamence rampage.png|thumb|200px|left|Salamence rampaging through the Pokémon Association]] Prior to the start of the series, {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}} was being held prisoner and experimented on by the [[Pokémon Association]] in order to create an artificial Orb to control it, as seen in a flashback in ''[[PS252|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XIV]]''. [[Zinnia]] eventually found out and had Salamence infiltrate the association in order to rescue it. Before getting to {{p|Rayquaza}}, however, it ran into {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} as they were playing together. Upon seeing them, Salamence charged and tried to bite them, but Ruby grabbed Sapphire and got them out of the way. He then sends out [[Nana]], [[Kiki]], and [[Rara]], who attack Salamence and deal heavy damage to it. Salamence recovered and struck Ruby with {{m|Dragon Claw}}, giving him a bloody head. Ruby ignored the pain and got Kiki to attack with {{m|Double-Edge}}. Salamence, finally having enough, ran off. After the battle, Ruby realized that, because of his aggressiveness, he caused Sapphire to cry, while Sapphire realized that because she was weak, she caused Ruby to get hurt. This incident made Ruby decided to focus on beauty and quit battles, while Sapphire learned how to become stronger. [[File:PS598.png|thumb|200px|Salamence battling Latios]] Salamence quickly arrived where Rayquaza was and went on a rampage from the pain it had from its injuries. Due to the lack of {{pkmn|Trainer}}s there, Salamence destroyed the restraining mechanism holding Rayquaza, allowing it to break free and escape. Salamence passed out shortly after. When {{adv|Norman}} arrived, he took a closer look at Salamence and realized that Ruby was the one who injured Salamence. He took the blame for what happened, and as a result, he was punished by being unable to become a [[Gym Leader]] for five years and made to track down Rayquaza. Salamence was also used by Zinnia to defend herself when she infiltrated [[Team Magma]] and [[Team Aqua]]. ===={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}==== [[File:Zinnia Mega Salamence Hyper Voice Adventures.png|thumb|200px|left|Aerilate activated as a Mega Salamence]] In ''[[PS598|Claydol Unleashes]]'', Salamence returned alongside its Trainer, Zinnia, inside the [[Sky Pillar]]. Deciding that Ruby and {{DL|Eon duo (Adventures)|Latios}} were a threat, she sent out Salamence to take care of them, who attacked with a powerful Dragon Claw. It then followed up with {{m|Fire Blast}}, but Ruby managed to distract {{p|Whismur|Aster}} and grab hold of Zinnia, forcing it to focus its attack toward Ruby. After getting Ruby off of her, Zinnia preceded to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] Salamence, with Ruby and Latios doing the same. Salamence attacked with {{m|Hyper Voice}}, which dealt {{type|Flying}} damage due to its [[Ability]], {{a|Aerilate}}. Despite the powerful attack, Latios survived and hit Salamence multiple times before finishing it off with {{m|Luster Purge}}. After the battle, Zinnia revealed to Ruby that Salamence was the one that attacked him nine years ago and thanked him for his help in the matter. In ''[[PS608|Groudon Returns]]'', Salamence battled in a [[Double Battle]] alongside {{p|Goodra}} against Sapphire's {{p|Aggron}}, [[Rono]], and her {{p|Gallade}}, Kirly. Salamence was able to attack Rono with {{m|Fire Fang}}, but took all the damage back and more from {{m|Metal Burst}}. The battle was stopped when Zinnia and Salamence fled for the rocket that [[Devon Corporation]] launched. Sapphire followed her with [[Troppy]] and attacked with {{m|Leaf Tornado}}; Salamence hung on and defeated the Fruit Pokémon, allowing Zinnia to destroy the rocket and the dimensional shifter. [[File:Zinnia and Salamence.png|thumb|200px|Salamence and Zinnia]] In [[PS615]], Salamence battled alongside [[Aster]]'s {{p|Noivern}} against Rara and Kirly in order to take back Rayquaza from Ruby and Sapphire. Salamence attacked the two with {{m|Dragon Pulse}}, but Rara used {{m|Misty Terrain}} to half the damage. Despite this, Noivern hit the two with {{m|Boomburst}} and knocked them out. Zinnia attempted to form a bond with Rayquaza, but it rejected her and stabbed her in the stomach. It then blasted Zinnia and Salamence into the ocean. Salamence was last seen in [[PS616]] with Rono, watching Zinnia talk with Ruby and Sapphire. ===Personality and characteristics=== Salamence is usually very reserved and observational, but becomes impatient and enraged when it takes too much damage. It has a close relationship with its {{pkmn|Trainer}} and [[Zinnia]] highly trusts Salamence, shown when she sent it to free {{DL|Super-ancient Pokémon (Adventures)|Rayquaza}} by itself. It is the powerhouse of Zinnia's team and is often used by her as a means of escape. ===Appearance=== :''See also: [[Mega Evolution]]'' {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{dragon color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{dragon color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{flying color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" |As a Mega Salamence |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Zinnia Mega Salamence Adventures.png|x180px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|Dragon|Flying|Zinnia {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Salamence Dragon Claw|1=Salamence Fire Blast|2=Mega Salamence Hyper Voice|3=Salamence Fire Fang|4=Salamence Dragon Pulse}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Dragon Claw|1=Fire Blast|2=Hyper Voice as Mega Salamence|3=Fire Fang|4=Dragon Pulse}}}} {{anmov|Dragon|Dragon Claw|PS252|The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon XIV}} {{anmov|Fire|Fire Blast|PS598|Claydol Unleashes}} {{anmov|Normal|Hyper Voice|PS599|Salamence Evolves}} {{anmov|Fire|Fire Fang|PS609|Kyogre Returns|rec=yes}} {{anmov|Dragon|Dragon Pulse|PS615|PS615|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|Flying}} *When Salamence is Mega Evolved, {{a|Aerilate}} causes its {{type|Normal}} moves to become {{type|Flying}}. ==In animation== [[File:Zinnia Mega Salamence Evolutions.png|thumb|250px|Mega Salamence in [[Pokémon Evolutions]]]] ===Pokémon Evolutions=== In ''[[PE06|The Wish]]'', [[Zinnia]] used Mega Salamence to battle {{ga|May}}'s Mega {{p|Rayquaza}}.
